title: Fredholm multiplication operators on Banach spaces of analytic functions on the open unit disk
summary: We identify properties of a Banach space $\mathcal{B}$ of analytic functions on the open unit disk $\mathbb{D}$ in the complex plane ensuring that a multiplication operator $M_ψ: \mathcal{B} \to\mathcal{B}$ is Fredholm if and only if its symbol $ψ$ is bounded away from $0$ near $\partial \mathbb{D}$. The properties we identify are shared by a wide variety of much-studied spaces, including the Hardy spaces $H^p(\mathbb{D})$, weighted Bergman spaces $A^p_ω(\mathbb{D})$, Hardy-Sobolev spaces $H^2_β(\mathbb{D})$, the spaces $S_j^p(\mathbb{D})$ of functions having $j$-th derivative in…
